definitions.gloss: mixing public and private matters; confusing official and personal business
definitions.explanation: Failing to maintain proper boundaries between one's public/professional role and private affairs. Generally used critically to describe improper behavior.

examples.japanese: {公私混同|こうしこんどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Mixing public and private matters is not good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公私混同|こうしこんどう}だ。
examples.english: Using company expenses for personal shopping is mixing public and private matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{私的|してき}→私的：06350_shiteki⟧な⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公私混同|こうしこんどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}ない→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧。
examples.english: When a boss asks a subordinate to handle personal errands, it can't help but be called a mixing of public and private.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of {公|こう} (public), {私|し} (private), {混|こん} (mix), and ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same/together). Almost always used with a negative connotation to criticize someone who blurs the line between their official duties and personal interests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公私混同|こうしこんどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to mix public and private matters
- {公私混同|こうしこんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ — to avoid mixing public and private
- ⟦{公私|こうし}→公私：21213_koushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧ — distinction between public and private

USAGE:
Commonly brought up in workplace ethics discussions. The phrase carries inherent criticism — it implies the person is abusing their position or being unprofessional. Related to the ideal of ⟦{公私|こうし}→公私：21213_koushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (maintaining the distinction between public and private).
